threat_event: Tax return information is disclosed to or used by Wealth without a valid IRC 7216 consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Referral interface sends records without checking consent; 2022 consent template too general; Wealth builds statistical compilations from referral fields
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T1 referral interface; SYS-W1 CRM and analytics
existing_controls: Consent form; CRM consent flag; coordinator training
treatment_plan: Consent register checked by the interface; new consent naming each product and service; stop statistical compilations without consent; re-consent integrated planning clients

threat_event: Business email compromise through the shared email tenant leads to taxpayer data theft, refund diversion, and fraudulent transfer requests across divisions
threat_source: Cybercriminal BEC groups targeting tax professionals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One tenant for all divisions; legacy authentication on 1,150 office intake mailboxes; 212 forwarding exceptions; no tax office inbox-rule alerts; call-back rule not always followed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4; SYS-T1; SYS-S1 Tax tenant; Wealth money movement
existing_controls: Number-matching MFA for users; email gateway; phishing exercises; Wealth call-back standard
treatment_plan: Block legacy authentication; remove forwarding exceptions; tax office inbox-rule alerts; refund-change call-back enforced in SYS-T1; cross-division BEC tabletop

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, IRS, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Each division has its own matrix; combined matrix never exercised; clocks differ (IRS next business day, Practice Cloud 24 or 72 hours, FTC and Regulation S-P 30 days, Form 8-K 4 business days)
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the combined matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Generative AI in tax preparation and in the Practice Cloud product is used without adequate governance
threat_source: AI model error; vendor terms; launch pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy or bias monitoring for AI-001; AI-002 pilot without IRC 7216 and Circular 230 review; Practice Cloud AI feature without SOC 2, sub-processor, or contract updates; Wealth AI notes not archived
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026); U.S.-only and no-training terms for AI-001
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10); conditions on each use case

threat_event: Seasonal staff or their stolen accounts are used to steal tax return information
threat_source: Malicious insider; identity thieves recruiting seasonal staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14% of seasonal accounts active before screening or training; disablement 9 days late; regional read access for office managers
existing_controls: Background checks; training; office-scoped roles
treatment_plan: No activation before screening and training; same-day disablement; regional access removed

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services during the filing season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and email connect all divisions; about 1,210 offices on one SD-WAN
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; quarterly restores
treatment_plan: Office segmentation on the SD-WAN; filing-season ransomware exercise; restore test of SYS-T1 at season volume

threat_event: A multi-tenant defect or attack on Practice Cloud exposes customer firms' client data and the Tax and Advisory tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared database with row-level security; 26,000 tenants plus the internal tenants
regulatory_driver: Customer contracts; N54-R01 (314.4(f)) flow-down; state third-party agent laws
existing_controls: Row-level security; per-tenant keys; isolation tests each release
treatment_plan: Independent tenant isolation test; customer MFA enforcement option

threat_event: Critical third-party outage in the filing season (tax engine vendor and transmitter, payroll SaaS, custodians)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single transmitter; single payroll SaaS; untested e-file gateway failover
existing_controls: Vendor SOC reports; contracts
treatment_plan: Gateway failover test; payroll contingency plan; vendor exit plans

threat_event: CPA Partners relies on group services that are not documented or contracted for security
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2021 administrative services agreement has no security or incident notice terms; inheritance not documented
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T3; CPA Partners engagement files including PHI held as a business associate
existing_controls: Group common controls in practice
treatment_plan: Amend the agreement; document inheritance; align the supplement
owner: CPA Partners risk and quality partner

threat_event: Division supplements drift from group policy and staff follow outdated rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CPA Partners supplement (2023) not aligned to 2026 policies
existing_controls: Annual policy review
treatment_plan: Re-issue the CPA Partners supplement; annual attestation for all divisions

threat_event: Detection gaps let an intrusion run undetected across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tax office inbox-rule alerts; Practice Cloud bulk-download alerts not in the group SIEM; portal and bank-field changes not reviewed
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; SIEM correlation for corporate and Wealth
treatment_plan: Onboard missing sources; new use cases for refund-change and bulk-download patterns

threat_event: Customer information is kept beyond the retention schedule and is exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purge jobs not running for client files older than 7 years in the SYS-T1 archive tier
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T1 archive; about 3.1 million former clients' files past retention
existing_controls: Retention schedule (7 years); Form 8879 minimum 3 years
treatment_plan: Run purge jobs; annual retention review

threat_event: Intercompany agreements lack the security and notice terms regulators expect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrated planning agreement (2022) lacks the Regulation S-P 72-hour term; administrative services agreement (2021) lacks security terms
affected_asset_or_process: Wealth; CPA Partners; Tax and Advisory
existing_controls: Intercompany services agreement amended 2025-11 for corporate services
treatment_plan: Amend both agreements

threat_event: A model provider breach exposes client documents sent by two divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two hosted model providers receive client documents; one is not on Practice Cloud's sub-processor list
existing_controls: No-training and U.S.-only terms for AI-001
treatment_plan: Annual assurance review of both providers; per-request logging to support notices

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes a data store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2% of resources deviate from guardrails without an approved exception
existing_controls: Preventive guardrails; daily compliance scan
treatment_plan: Close deviations; exceptions expire

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida offices and headquarters near a filing deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters and about 21% of individual clients in Florida; October 15 deadline falls in hurricane season
existing_controls: Remote work for permanent staff; cloud hosting outside Florida
treatment_plan: Office relocation plan; early extensions for affected clients; IRS disaster relief tracking

threat_event: The group files a late or inaccurate Form 8-K Item 1.05 disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality decisions depend on facts from three divisions
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity
treatment_plan: Materiality step in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Privileged access to shared platforms is misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Few standing privileges; PAM with recording
existing_controls: Just-in-time PAM; session recording
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of PAM grants

threat_event: A vendor gives a country of concern access to bulk U.S. financial data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offshore development contractors; bulk personal financial data
existing_controls: Vendor screening for countries of concern; no offshore access to production
treatment_plan: Annual attestation from vendors with access

threat_event: Data stolen from tax files is used to impersonate integrated planning clients to Wealth advisers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tax documents hold account numbers and identity details for 210,000 Wealth households
existing_controls: Wealth call-back to the number of record; custodian call-backs
treatment_plan: Red flag for requests that cite tax documents; adviser training
